title: July 23, 2026 KPN Webinar Recording Now LIVE
summary: Unable to join today's KPN webinar? The recording is now live.
bodyHtml:
🎙️ Trang Nguyen presented on "Rare-variant association studies: a primer, a problem, and a proposal for baseline masks."

🧬 Topics covered:

  • A brief primer on rare-variant association studies (RVAS)
  • A widespread problem regarding "masks" in RVAS
  • A proposal for baseline masks to increase consistency and replicability in future studies

🔗 Explore Trang's paper before the talk: https://www.nature.com/articles/s41588-026-02597-9

💻 The webinar recording is now LIVE, watch here: https://youtu.be/FiheGHamfkM
